   ID: doc_business_savings_accounts_gold_saver_account_009
   Score: 22.9498
   Content: ## APY bonus amounts by eligible business card
The following APY bonuses are available on your Gold Saver Account when you hold an eligible Rho Business Rewards Card. Each bonus is added as percentage points to your existing Gold Saver Account APY.

- Business Silver Rewards Card: 0.2% percentage points
- Business Gold Rewards Card: 0.4% percentage points
- Business Platinum Rewards Card: 0.6% percentage points

### Summary table
| Eligible card | APY bonus (percentage points) |
| --- | --- |
| Business Silver Rewards Card | 0.2% |
| Business Gold Rewards Card | 0.4% |
| Business Platinum Rewards Card | 0.6% |

## How the APY bonus is applied
- The applicable APY bonus is added to the APY associated with your current Gold Saver Account balance tier.
- The adjusted APY (base APY plus any applicable bonus) is used to calculate interest accrued on your Gold Saver Account.
- If your card eligibility changes, your Gold Saver Account APY will be updated after the change is processed and reflected in your account details.

## Example calculations
- If your base Gold Saver APY is X%, and you hold a Business Silver Rewards Card, your effective APY becomes X% + 0.2%.
- If your base Gold Saver APY is X%, and you hold a Business Gold Rewards Card, your effective APY becomes X% + 0.4%.
- If your base Gold Saver APY is X%, and you hold a Business Platinum Rewards Card, your effective APY becomes X% + 0.6%.

## How to confirm your APY bonus
1. Sign in to your Rho account.
2. Open your Gold Saver Account details.
3. Check the APY displayed; if you are eligible, it will include the applicable APY bonus shown above.

2. Internal: Downgrading a Credit Card to a No-Annual-Fee Card
   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_008
   Score: 20.5710
   Content: ## When to Offer a Downgrade

Offer a downgrade in these scenarios:

1. Retention protocol: The customer wants to close due to annual fee concerns and has been a customer for less than 2 years (not eligible for annual fee waiver).
2. Customer request: The customer explicitly asks to downgrade to avoid annual fees.

## Available No-Annual-Fee Card Options

- Personal cards: Bronze Rewards Card (no annual fee)
- Business cards: Business Bronze Rewards Card (no annual fee)

Customers may only downgrade within the same category (personal to personal, business to business).

## Downgrade Process

1. Verify the customer's identity using standard procedures.
2. Confirm the customer wants to proceed and understands benefit changes.
3. Inform the customer that account history and credit line will be preserved, and rewards rates/benefits will change to match the new tier.
4. Use downgrade_credit_card_3847 to process the downgrade.

Tool arguments for downgrade_credit_card_3847:
- credit_card_account_id (string, required): The credit card account ID to downgrade.
- user_id (string, required): The customer's unique identifier.
- target_card_type (string, required): One of 'Bronze Rewards Card' (personal) or 'Business Bronze Rewards Card' (business).

## Important Notes

- Credit limit, account number, and account history are preserved during a downgrade.
- Unredeemed rewards points transfer at the same value.
- The downgrade takes effect immediately; the customer continues using the existing physical card until the new card arrives, typically within several business days.
- If the annual fee was paid recently, the customer may be eligible for a prorated refund.

3. Internal: Credit Card Rewards - Points vs Cash Back Representation
   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006
   Score: 19.9205
   Content: ## Rewards representation
Due to a legacy backend migration that has not yet been completed, all credit card rewards in the transaction database are stored as 'points' regardless of whether the card is a cash back card or a points-based card. For cash back cards (Bronze Rewards Card, Silver Rewards Card, Gold Rewards Card, Platinum Rewards Card, Diamond Elite Card, Crypto-Cash Back, Business Bronze Rewards Card, Business Silver Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card, Silver Zoom Card, Business Gold Rewards Card, and Business Platinum Rewards Card), these 'points' should be interpreted as cash back with a conversion rate of 1 point = $0.01 when redeemed as a statement credit or as a credit to the user's Rho-Bank checking account. For example, 250 points equals $2.50 in cash back, which matches a 2.5% cash back rate on a $100 purchase. The only true points-based card is the EcoCard, which earns 'sustainability points' (5 points per dollar on green purchases, 1 point per dollar on other purchases) that also redeem at $0.01 per point when redeemed as a statement credit or checking account credit.

When using the transfer_to_human_agents tool, select the most accurate reason code from the tiered list below. Reasons are organized into 4 priority tiers - always select from the highest tier that applies.

| technical_system_error | System error or outage preventing completion of the customer's request |
| customer_demands_after_unavailable_offer_refusal | Customer asked about offers/promotions that don't exist in the system, you informed them the offers aren't available, customer persisted multiple times, and now demands human |

## TIER 3 (LOWER PRIORITY) - Customer Disposition Reasons

These describe customer state rather than specific operational scenarios.

6. Credit Card Rewards Redemption Options
   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_008
   Score: 18.9743
   Content: ## Redemption options and values
Rho-Bank credit card rewards points can be redeemed through several different methods, each with its own redemption value. The available redemption options are:

**Statement Credit** - 1 point = $0.01 (1 cent per point). Points are applied directly to your credit card balance to reduce your next statement. Minimum redemption: 500 points ($5.00).

**Rho-Bank Checking Account Credit** - 1 point = $0.01 (1 cent per point). Points are deposited directly into your linked Rho-Bank checking account. Minimum redemption: 500 points ($5.00). Must have an active Rho-Bank checking account.

**Rho-Bank Travel Portal** - 1 point = $0.0125 (1.25 cents per point). Book flights, hotels, and car rentals through the Rho-Bank Travel Portal for 25% more value. For example, 10,000 points = $125 in travel purchases. Minimum redemption: 2,500 points ($31.25 value).

**Gift Cards** - 1 point = $0.008 to $0.01 (0.8 to 1 cent per point, varies by retailer). Redeem for gift cards from over 100 partner retailers. Popular retailers (Amazon, Target, Starbucks) offer 1 cent per point, while less common retailers such as safeway may offer reduced rates as low as 0.8 cents per point. Minimum redemption: 1,000 points.

**Charitable Donations** - 1 point = $0.01 (1 cent per point). Donate your points to one of Rho-Bank's partner charities. 100% of the value goes to the charity with no processing fees. Minimum redemption: 250 points ($2.50).

**Merchandise** - 1 point = $0.005 to $0.008 (0.5 to 0.8 cents per point). Redeem points for electronics, home goods, and other merchandise through the Rho-Bank Rewards Mall. No minimum redemption.

**Airline Miles Transfer** - 1 point = 1 mile (value varies by airline program, typically 1-2 cents per mile). Transfer points to partner airline frequent flyer programs including Delta SkyMiles, United MileagePlus, and American AAdvantage. Transfers are processed in increments of 1,000 points. Processing time: 24-48 hours. Note: Only available for Gold Rewards Card, Platinum Rewards Card, Diamond Elite Card, and Business Platinum Rewards Card.

Redemption values and minimums are subject to change. Points do not expire as long as the account remains open and in good standing.

   Content: ## Closure Process

1. Verify the customer's identity using standard verification procedures.
2. Confirm all eligibility requirements are met per 'How can I close a credit card account?':
   - Outstanding balance must be $0.00 dollars
   - No pending disputes (pending disputes allowed: No)

   - No pending replacement cards

- credit_card_account_id (string): The unique identifier for the credit card account to be closed. This can be found in the customer's account profile or by looking up their credit card accounts.

### Post-Closure Communication

- The customer will receive a confirmation email and a final statement within several business days after the account is closed.
- If asked, remind the customer:
  - Unredeemed rewards can be redeemed for 45 days after the closure request; thereafter, they are forfeited.
  - If an annual fee posted recently, a full refund may apply if the closure occurs within 37 days of the fee charge.

   Content: ## Eligibility Requirements for Account Closure

   Content: When a customer reports a lost or stolen debit card, there is a risk that other cards in their wallet were also compromised. Agents must follow this cross-product security protocol to protect the customer's full relationship with Rho-Bank.

## Required Security Check

When a customer reports a lost or stolen debit card:
1) Complete the standard debit card freeze/close procedure
2) Check if the customer has any Rho-Bank credit cards on file
3) If yes, proactively offer to order a replacement credit card as a security precaution
4) Explain that wallet theft often involves multiple cards and this protects against potential fraud

## How to Check for Credit Cards

Use get_credit_card_accounts_by_user to retrieve any credit card accounts for the customer. This will return all active and closed credit card accounts.

## Offering Credit Card Protection

If the customer has one or more credit cards:
- Inform them that you noticed they also have a credit card with Rho-Bank
- Ask if their credit card was also in the lost/stolen wallet
- Offer to order a replacement credit card with a new card number to prevent any unauthorized charges
- If they decline, note in the account that the offer was made

## Why This Matters

Customers who lose their wallet often focus on their debit card and forget about credit cards until fraudulent charges appear. Proactively offering this protection demonstrates excellent customer service and reduces fraud losses for the bank.

## Agent Script Example

"I see that you also have a [Card Type] credit card with us. Was that card also in your lost wallet? If so, I can order a replacement card with a new card number to protect you from any potential fraud. Would you like me to do that for you?"

8. Checking Pending Replacement Card Orders (Internal)
   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_005
   Score: 23.4734
   Content: ## Purpose

To check if a credit card account has any pending replacement card orders, use the get_pending_replacement_orders_5765 tool. Call it with the credit_card_account_id to check if there are any outstanding replacement card orders for that account. This is important to verify before processing account closures, as accounts with pending replacement orders cannot be closed until the replacement is delivered or the order is cancelled.

## Prerequisites

- You have the correct credit_card_account_id.
- You have permission to use the get_pending_replacement_orders_5765 tool.
- You can authenticate to the internal environment where the tool is available.

## Procedure

1. Locate the credit_card_account_id for the account you are reviewing.
2. Invoke get_pending_replacement_orders_5765 with the credit_card_account_id parameter.
3. Review the response for any outstanding replacement card orders.
4. Document the result in the customer’s case notes before proceeding with any account closure steps.

### Example invocation (pseudo)

- Input:
  - credit_card_account_id: <credit_card_account_id>

- Call:
  - get_pending_replacement_orders_5765({
    credit_card_account_id: "<credit_card_account_id>"
  })

### Example response (structure)

- Successful response:
  - orders: a collection of replacement order records, or an empty collection if none are pending

- Order record fields (typical):
  - order_id
  - status (examples: pending, shipped, delivered, cancelled)
  - created_at
  - latest_event_at
  - notes (optional)

## Interpreting Results

- No pending orders:
  - The response contains an empty collection of orders.
  - You may proceed with account closure checks per standard procedures.

- One or more orders returned:
  - Treat the account as having pending replacement activity unless every order is clearly delivered or cancelled.
  - Do not proceed with account closure until at least one of the following is true:
    - The replacement is delivered.
    - The order is cancelled.

- Mixed statuses:
  - If any order is in a non-final state (for example, pending or shipped), consider the account blocked from closure.
  - If all orders are final (delivered or cancelled), proceed with standard closure checks.

## Required Actions Before Account Closure

- If orders are pending:
  - Inform the relevant team that the account cannot be closed.
  - Monitor until delivery or confirm cancellation of the order.
- If no orders are pending:
  - Note the check outcome in the case record and continue with the closure process.

## Troubleshooting

- Invalid credit_card_account_id:
  - Re-verify you are using the account-level identifier, not a card-level identifier.
  - Confirm the identifier format and source.

- Permission or access denied:
  - Ensure your role has access to run get_pending_replacement_orders_5765.
  - Re-authenticate if your session may have expired.

- Empty or ambiguous response:
  - Retry the call.
  - If ambiguity persists, escalate to the support engineering queue with the call context and the credit_card_account_id.

## Best Practices

- Always run this check immediately before initiating any account closure workflow.
- Record the timestamp and outcome of the check in the customer record.
- If multiple orders appear, review each status and proceed only when all orders are delivered or cancelled.

2. No pending replacement cards: If a replacement has been ordered and not yet received or activated, a closure cannot proceed.

You earn a higher rate when your balance reaches the $25,000 threshold.

- Balances under $25,000: 2.5% APY
- Balances at or above $25,000: 4.0% APY

- Business Silver Rewards Card: +0.1% APY
- Business Gold Rewards Card: +0.3% APY
- Business Platinum Rewards Card: +0.55% APY

|--------------------------|----------|-----------------------------------|---------------------------------|--------------------------------------|

| $25,000 or more          | 4.0% | 4.0% + 0.1% = 4.1% | 4.0% + 0.3% = 4.3% | 4.0% + 0.55% = 4.55% |

## Examples

- $24,000 balance, no card: 2.5% APY → about $600 in interest over a full year.

- $40,000 balance with a Business Gold Rewards Card: 4.0% + 0.3% = 4.3% APY → about $1,720 in interest over a full year.

- Keep a buffer above $25,000 to avoid brief dips that could move you into the lower APY tier.

The following APY bonuses apply to your Emerald Saver when you hold and link an eligible Business Rewards Card:

| Card Tier | APY Bonus (percentage points added to Emerald Saver APY) |
|---|---|
| Business Silver Rewards Card | 0.12% |
| Business Gold Rewards Card | 0.28% |
| Business Platinum Rewards Card | 0.52% |

Note: The bonus is additive to your Emerald Saver APY (i.e., it increases your APY by the stated number of percentage points).

## Eligibility and Application Rules

- You must hold an eligible Business Rewards Card and the Emerald Saver under the same legal business entity.
- Your card must be open and in good standing for the bonus to apply.
- Only one card-based APY bonus applies per Emerald Saver account. If you hold multiple eligible cards, the single highest tier bonus is applied.
- The bonus begins after Rho verifies your eligible card status and linkage to your Emerald Saver. It appears in your displayed APY and applies to interest accrued from the effective date forward.
- Interest accrued before the bonus effective date is not adjusted or retroactively increased.
- If you upgrade or downgrade your eligible card, your APY bonus changes to match the new tier once the change is verified.
- If the eligible card is closed, suspended, or becomes ineligible, the APY bonus is removed.

## How to Activate Your Bonus

1. Confirm your Emerald Saver and eligible Business Rewards Card are registered to the same business.
2. Link your eligible card to your Emerald Saver:
   - In online banking, open your Emerald Saver account and use the option to link an eligible Business Rewards Card; or
   - Contact Rho-Bank support to request linkage.
3. Await confirmation that the card is linked and eligible.
4. Verify your displayed Emerald Saver APY reflects the applicable bonus.

Tip: After linkage, check your APY display and your next interest accrual period to confirm the bonus is in effect.

## Changes in Card Tier: What You Can Expect

- Moving from Business Silver to Business Gold increases your APY bonus from 0.12% to 0.28%.
- Moving from Business Gold to Business Platinum increases your APY bonus from 0.28% to 0.52%.
- If you no longer hold an eligible card, you lose the applicable bonus (e.g., up to 0.52% if you previously held Business Platinum).

## Troubleshooting

- The bonus is not showing: Confirm the card is linked to the same business entity, is open and in good standing, and that linkage has been verified.
- Multiple eligible cards: Only the single highest tier bonus applies; bonuses do not stack.
- Timing questions: The bonus appears after verification and applies prospectively to interest accruals going forward.

  - No. The Rho fee is $0.00 per transaction. ATM operators may still charge their own surcharges.

  - Once you reach $50 in rebated out-of-network ATM surcharges for the month, additional surcharges are not rebated.

   ID: doc_business_checking_accounts_world_blue_009

   Content: ## What you pay at foreign ATMs

- Rho foreign ATM withdrawal fee: 0% (minimum $0.00)
- Foreign ATM fee rebates: Up to $100 per calendar month for fees charged by foreign ATM operators on cash withdrawals

You will not be charged a Rho fee for international ATM withdrawals. If the foreign ATM operator adds its own fee, we rebate those fees automatically up to the monthly cap.

### Snapshot of foreign ATM costs
| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Rho foreign ATM withdrawal fee | 0% |
| Rho foreign ATM withdrawal fee minimum | $0.00 |
| Maximum monthly rebate for foreign ATM fees | $100 |

## Monthly rebate rules

- Coverage: Rebates apply to fees assessed by foreign ATM operators on cash withdrawals.
- Cap: We rebate up to a total of $100 in a calendar month. Fees above this amount will not be reimbursed for that month.
- Posting: Rebates are issued automatically after the withdrawal and associated fee post to your account. No enrollment or receipt submission is required.

Tip: Keep your ATM receipt when a foreign ATM displays or charges a fee; it’s useful for reference if you need to follow up.

## How to make a fee-free withdrawal abroad

1. Use your card at an international ATM that accepts it.
2. When prompted, select a withdrawal from checking.
3. If asked about currency choice, choose to be charged in the local currency rather than having the ATM convert the amount.
4. Complete your withdrawal. If the ATM charges a fee, it will typically display it before you confirm.

## Example

- You withdraw the equivalent of $200 at a foreign ATM.
- Rho foreign ATM withdrawal fee: 0% with a $0.00 minimum, so you pay $0 to Rho.
- The ATM operator charges a $5 fee. We automatically rebate $5, counting toward your $100 monthly cap.

   Content: ## Overview

Silver Account holders who also have a Platinum Rewards Card receive enhanced withdrawal privileges. Your monthly withdrawal limit is increased by 5 additional free withdrawals, bringing your total to 10 + 5 = 15 withdrawals per month. This benefit is automatically applied when both accounts are linked under the same customer profile. Combined with the existing 15 ATM fee rebates and 0.025% relationship bonus, Platinum Rewards Card holders get an elevated Silver Account experience.

- Platinum Rewards Card: +0.2%
- Diamond Elite Card: +0.25%

## What you receive as a Platinum Rewards Card holder

- Additional free withdrawals: +5 per month on top of your standard 10 free withdrawals
- Total free withdrawals per month: 10 + 5 = 15
- ATM fee relief: Up to 15 in ATM fee rebates each month
- Earnings boost: An additional 0.025% relationship bonus added to your APY when eligible

## Activation and eligibility

- The enhanced withdrawal limit is automatically applied when your Silver Account and Platinum Rewards Card are linked under the same customer profile.
- The 0.025% relationship bonus and 15 ATM fee rebates apply in the same profile-linked setup.

### How to confirm your accounts are linked

1. Sign in to Rho-Bank Online Banking or the mobile app.
2. Open your customer profile and review your list of accounts and cards.
3. Verify that your Silver Account and Platinum Rewards Card appear under the same customer profile.
4. If you do not see both products under one profile, consolidate them to a single profile or contact us for assistance.

## Using your monthly withdrawal allowance

- Counting method: Any transaction classified as a withdrawal under your Silver Account terms counts toward your monthly total of 15 free withdrawals.
- Cycle timing: Your free withdrawal count resets at the start of each monthly statement cycle.
- Beyond the limit: Transactions above your free monthly total may be subject to standard Silver Account withdrawal charges.

Example:
- You make 12 withdrawals in a month: all 12 are free.
- You make 15 withdrawals in a month: all 15 are free.
- You make 16 withdrawals in a month: the first 15 are free; the 16th may incur standard charges.

## ATM fee rebates

- You are eligible for up to 15 in ATM fee rebates each month.
- Rebates apply after ATM fees post to your Silver Account; check your transaction history for the corresponding credit within the same month.

## Relationship bonus APY

- When your Silver Account and Platinum Rewards Card are linked under the same customer profile, an additional 0.025% is added to your APY as a relationship bonus.
- The relationship bonus is reflected in your APY while eligibility is maintained.

## Troubleshooting and tips

- If you do not see the extra withdrawals or 0.025% reflected, confirm both products are under the same customer profile.
- Check that you are within the current monthly statement cycle for the added withdrawals to apply.
- Review your transaction history to verify ATM fee charges and corresponding rebates up to 15 for the month.

8. Platinum Rewards Card: Rebate Eligibility and Calcluation
   ID: doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_010
   Score: 10.7212
   Content: ## Eligibility for the Annual Fee Rebate

- The Platinum Rewards Card annual fee rebate is earned only if you meet the required monthly spending threshold in every month of your cardmember year.
- A single month below the threshold disqualifies you from receiving the rebate for that entire cardmember year; there is no partial or prorated rebate.
- If your first cardmember year’s annual fee is waived under a promotional offer, the rebate does not apply to that year. Eligibility begins with the next cardmember year in which the annual fee is billed.

## How the Monthly Calculation Window Works

- Start date: Your first monthly window begins on your account opening date.
- Refresh cadence: Each new monthly window begins on the same calendar day each month (the monthly anniversary of your account opening) and ends the day before the next monthly anniversary.
- Cardmember year: Your rebate evaluation covers 12 consecutive monthly windows, starting from your account opening date (or from the start of the first fee-billed cardmember year after any promotional waiver).
- Posting date rule: Only transactions that post within a given monthly window count toward that month’s threshold. Authorization dates do not control eligibility.

### Example timeline (no amounts)
- Account opened on the 15th:
  - Month 1 window: 15th to the 14th (inclusive by posting date)
  - Month 2 window: 15th to the 14th
  - …
  - Month 12 window: 15th to the 14th
- You must meet the monthly threshold in all 12 windows to earn the rebate for that cardmember year.

## What Counts Toward the Monthly Threshold

Included
- Net purchases posted to your Platinum Rewards Card, including purchases made by authorized users.
- Purchases made using virtual card numbers associated with your account (counted the same as your physical card).
- International purchases, provided they post as purchases.

Excluded
- Fees, interest charges, and adjustments.
- Cash advances and cash-equivalent transactions (for example, money orders, traveler’s checks, and similar cash-like activity).
- Balance transfers.
- Person-to-person money transfers and funding transactions that are coded as cash equivalents.
- Disputed transactions while unresolved.

Adjustments
- Returns, refunds, or credits reduce the monthly total in the window in which the credit posts. A return that posts in a later month can cause you to miss the threshold for that later month.
- Merchant delays can affect posting dates; only posted transactions inside the window count.

## Evaluation and Rebate Posting

- Eligibility is assessed after the close of your 12th monthly window in the cardmember year.
- If you qualified, the rebate is applied as a statement credit to your Platinum Rewards Card account after the annual fee for that cardmember year is billed.
- If the account is closed or product-changed before the year-end evaluation or rebate posting, the rebate will not be awarded.

## Practical Tips

- Track posted transactions by your monthly anniversary dates, not by statement cycle or calendar month.
- Leave a buffer above the monthly threshold to account for late postings or potential returns.
- Confirm that authorized user and virtual card purchases have posted before the monthly window closes.

   Content: ## Where ATM fees apply for Navy Blue
- Out-of-network usage: Any transaction at a non‑Rho ATM is assessed a per‑transaction fee of $2.50.
- International usage: ATM cash withdrawals at foreign (international) ATMs are assessed a fee of 3% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $5.00.
- Operator surcharges: The ATM owner may charge an additional surcharge at the terminal. This surcharge is separate from Rho fees.

## Fee schedule
| Scenario | Fee | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Domestic out‑of‑network ATM transaction | $2.50 per transaction | Applies at non‑Rho ATMs in the U.S. |
| International ATM cash withdrawal | 3% of withdrawal amount (min. $5.00) | Applies at foreign ATMs outside the U.S. |
| Monthly rebates for out‑of‑network usage | Up to $10 per calendar month | Rebates are capped at the monthly limit. |

## How international ATM withdrawal fees are calculated
- Calculation: The fee equals the greater of:
  - 3% of the cash withdrawal amount, or
  - $5.00 (minimum)
- Threshold for the minimum to apply: The minimum applies when the withdrawal amount is less than or equal to $5.00 divided by 3%.

## When fees can combine
- If you use an international ATM that is also out‑of‑network, both the $2.50 out‑of‑network fee and the international withdrawal fee of 3% (minimum $5.00) can apply.
- ATM operator surcharges, if any, are in addition to the above.

## Monthly rebate details
- Rho rebates up to $10 in out‑of‑network ATM fees per calendar month.
- The monthly cap is the maximum total rebated; fees above this amount are your responsibility after the cap is reached.

## Tips to minimize ATM costs
- Use Rho ATMs whenever possible to avoid the out‑of‑network fee of $2.50.
- For international cash needs, consider making larger, less frequent withdrawals to reduce the impact of the $5.00 minimum relative to the withdrawal amount.
- Always review any on‑screen ATM operator surcharge disclosures before completing a transaction.

3. Internal: Credit Card Rewards - Points vs Cash Back Representation
   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006
   Score: 4.0707
   Content: ## Rewards representation
Due to a legacy backend migration that has not yet been completed, all credit card rewards in the transaction database are stored as 'points' regardless of whether the card is a cash back card or a points-based card. For cash back cards (Bronze Rewards Card, Silver Rewards Card, Gold Rewards Card, Platinum Rewards Card, Diamond Elite Card, Crypto-Cash Back, Business Bronze Rewards Card, Business Silver Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card, Silver Zoom Card, Business Gold Rewards Card, and Business Platinum Rewards Card), these 'points' should be interpreted as cash back with a conversion rate of 1 point = $0.01 when redeemed as a statement credit or as a credit to the user's Rho-Bank checking account. For example, 250 points equals $2.50 in cash back, which matches a 2.5% cash back rate on a $100 purchase. The only true points-based card is the EcoCard, which earns 'sustainability points' (5 points per dollar on green purchases, 1 point per dollar on other purchases) that also redeem at $0.01 per point when redeemed as a statement credit or checking account credit.

## Ways to Redeem Your Rewards

Rho-Bank offers several flexible options for redeeming your credit card rewards, so you can choose the method that works best for you:

### Statement Credit
Apply your rewards directly to your credit card balance. This is one of the simplest redemption options—your rewards are converted to a dollar amount and subtracted from what you owe on your next statement.

### Rho-Bank Checking Account Deposit
If you have a Rho-Bank checking account, you can transfer your rewards directly into your checking account as cash. This gives you immediate access to your rewards for everyday spending.

### Travel Through the Rho-Bank Travel Portal
Book flights, hotels, and car rentals through the Rho-Bank Travel Portal and your rewards may be worth even more. Many of our cards offer enhanced value when you redeem for travel purchases through our portal.

### Gift Cards
Choose from a wide selection of gift cards from popular retailers, restaurants, and entertainment venues. Gift cards make great presents or a nice treat for yourself.

### Charitable Donations
Feel good about your rewards by donating them to one of our partner charities. It's an easy way to give back while putting your rewards to meaningful use.

### Merchandise
Browse the Rho-Bank Rewards Mall for electronics, home goods, apparel, and more. You can use your rewards to shop for items you want without spending cash.

### Airline Miles Transfer
For select premium cards, you can transfer your rewards to partner airline frequent flyer programs. This can be a great option if you're working toward a specific travel goal.

## Tips for Maximizing Value

- Check the redemption rates for each option, as the value per point can vary
- Some redemption methods offer better value than others—travel redemptions often provide the best return
- Keep an eye out for special promotions that may offer bonus value on certain redemption types
- There's no rush—your rewards don't expire as long as your account is open and in good standing

## How to Redeem

You can redeem your rewards anytime through the Rho-Bank mobile app, online banking at rhobank.com, or by calling our customer service team at 1-800-RHO-BANK. If you have questions about which redemption option is right for you, our team is happy to help you make the most of your rewards.
